explanation: He took light-heavyweight gold aged 18. He changed his name in 1964, soon after beating Sonny Liston to become world heavyweight champion.

claims.text: Muhammad Ali, then named Cassius Clay, won the Olympic light-heavyweight boxing gold medal at the 1960 Rome Olympics.
Sonny Liston, Joe Frazier and Floyd Patterson were other boxers, not names that Muhammad Ali used.
Cassius Clay was 18 when he won Olympic gold in 1960.
Clay took the name Muhammad Ali in 1964, shortly after beating Sonny Liston for the world heavyweight title.
